summary.intent: Execute a GSD manager session for CipherBox v1.1 milestone to discuss, plan, and implement three gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) identified during a UAT audit (PR #484).
summary.outcome: All three phases were fully executed and marked complete across 8+8+7 plans using wave-based parallel worktree execution. Phase 42 added guardedUnpin with advisory locking and a pending_unpins outbox; Phase 43 added a persist-backed WriteQueue journal across macOS/Linux/Windows platforms; Phase 44 implemented three-way merge with 4-attempt backoff for IPNS 409 conflicts. Milestone v1.1 is now complete.

repo: Kubo v0.40 runs with `server` profile + swarm port 4001 exposed publicly in staging (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72), meaning all pinned CIDs are broadcast as DHT provider records — CIDs are public identifiers by design even though blobs are encrypted.

The unpin endpoint POST /ipfs/unpin was protected only by JwtAuthGuard with no ownership check; any JWT holder (signup is open via Web3Auth) could destroy another user's pinned content while leaving their quota row intact.
CIDs are discoverable via three non-compromise paths: DHT crawlers harvesting provider records, IPNS resolution of published folder/file names, and share recipients who retain CIDs after revocation.
shared-write.ts:~450 drops prunedCids without calling unpin — there is no legitimate cross-user unpin path in the current codebase.

pnpm + jest flag separator gotcha: `pnpm --filter @pkg test -- --testPathPattern=X` breaks because pnpm inserts its own `--`, causing jest to treat the pattern as a positional regex. Correct form: `pnpm --filter @pkg exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`.
1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` on git commands inside the agent; signing failures require the user to restart the 1Password app.
gsd commit helper returns `committed: false` as a false negative — always verify with `git log`, never blind-retry.

Cross-package dist staleness is a recurring source of spurious typecheck failures: when sdk-core or sdk sources change, dependent packages typecheck against the stale built dist until rebuilt with `pnpm build`.

WinFsp targets cannot be compiled on macOS due to pre-existing cross-compilation failures in `windows-future` and `winfsp-sys` registry crates — use `cargo check` for Rust project-code verification instead.

No .prettierignore existed before this session; prettier was mangling .planning/ markdown tables and GSD-controlled files. Created at repo root ignoring .planning/, .claude/agents/gsd-*.md, .claude/commands/gsd/, .claude/gsd-core/, .claude/gsd-pristine/, .claude/gsd-migration-journal/, .claude/gsd-local-patches/.

code.finding: Upload compensation path fires a global Kubo pin/rm without ownership check — same cross-tenant destruction surface as the primary unpin endpoint. Rerouted through guardedUnpin in plan 42-05.

Kubo v0.40 configured with `server` profile (disables local-network discovery only, keeps full public DHT) and swarm port 4001 exposed tcp+udp — the node actively advertises provider records for every pinned CID to the public DHT.

updateFileMetadata caller needed to consume new CAS return shape {ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids} and pass baseChildren to updateFolderMetadataAndPublish for conflict-merge correctness.

prunedCids were dropped here without unpinning — confirmed no legitimate cross-user unpin exists through writable-share saves. Also required callers baseChildren sweep for IPNS conflict handling (plan 44-04).

Had a spawn_journal.remove call on the upload-success path that should be gated on per-file IPNS publish success (CR-08 alignment). Fixed post-verification: removal call removed, journal entry cleared only after successful parent-pointer publish.

updateFolderMetadataAndPublish needed a baseChildren parameter for three-way merge and must return publishedChildren (the exact children at successful publish time) so the next write composes from the correct merged base — missing this caused a one-write-later lost-update regression.

workflow: cleanup-wave must be run from the repo root, not from inside an agent worktree — running from a worktree path causes false base_mismatch errors because the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd.

cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun. When a wave cleanup is interrupted, write a reduced manifest containing only the remaining unmerged entries rather than re-running the full manifest.
Worktree cruft (node_modules, .husky/_) blocks merge operations — remove before calling cleanup-wave.
openapi.json can accumulate formatting-only drift as a side effect of `nest build` (564+ lines). Restore with `git checkout --` before the wave merge to keep diffs clean.

The decision to use silent 2XX + audit log (vs 403) for no-row unpin avoids oracle risk (existence oracle), preserves idempotent REST semantics, and prevents benign race 403s from polluting monitoring dashboards.

Transactional row-delete + refcount + outbox in a single Postgres transaction + per-CID pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) closes the deduped-CID concurrent unpin race without needing a reconciliation job.
A pin ls drift report should be detect-only (metric + log), not auto-GC — auto-deleting untracked pins is dangerous for pre-existing historical orphans or ops pins.

friction: 1Password SSH commit signing required multiple retries and one full app restart mid-session; dangerouslyDisableSandbox had to be used on all subsequent git commits.
Planner agent hit a socket connection error after writing plans 01-03, requiring a filesystem fallback check and a continuation planner spawn for plans 04-08.
cleanup-wave cwd bug caused false base_mismatch failures when run from inside a worktree path — discovered and worked around by running from repo root.
cleanup-wave not idempotent: already-merged entries blocked reruns, requiring reduced manifest files for each interrupted wave.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD in the repo after all conflicts auto-resolved but the commit step failed — required manual `git commit --no-edit` and worktree/branch cleanup.
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build side effects contaminated the merge diff — had to restore before each wave merge.
gsd commit helper false negatives: reported committed: false while commits actually landed, wasting verification cycles.
prettier mangled VALIDATION.md table by splitting a testPathPattern pipe into table columns — caused a plan checker warning requiring a manual edit.
Cross-package dist staleness caused 8 spurious tsc errors after the phase-44 gap wave merge, requiring sdk and sdk-core rebuilds to confirm there was no real code gap.
Three session limit hits (Europe/Berlin timezone resets) interrupted mid-wave execution, requiring state reconstruction and re-dispatch of in-progress executors.
User accidentally sent garbled text ('touring wyatt web bossy') twice, triggering tool use cancellations during active wave execution.
open_items: SECURITY.md is missing for phase 42 — the code_review gate flagged it and recommended running /gsd:secure-phase 42 to generate it.
Phase 43 has 4 UAT items requiring human runtime verification (43-UAT.md): FUSE crash-and-replay, WriteParked tray notification, conflict re-arm, Windows mount replay — cannot be automated.
Pending-uploads UI deferred: when files are WriteParked, a richer in-app upload queue view was noted as a future improvement but not scoped into phase 43.
BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring deferred: the server-side fix handles BYO via advisory unpin rows, but wiring provider.unpin into BYO delete flows was explicitly deferred out of phase 42.
Writable-share prunedCids leak deferred: shared-write.ts drops prunedCids without unpinning — pre-existing and out of scope for phase 42-44.
Rust FUSE IPNS conflict handling parity deferred (D-09 in phase 44 CONTEXT): Rust fuse crate has no conflict-retry equivalent; deferred as a separate phase.
REQUIREMENTS traceability gap noted as pre-existing at phase 44 close-out — some requirement IDs lack explicit coverage citations in plans.
Windows WinFsp build cannot be fully verified on macOS CI — cross-compilation failures in windows-future and winfsp-sys are pre-existing and unresolved.
